conventions: C1 2% log box; C2 3-box reversal, high/low, one direction per week; C3 first column X from bar 0; C4 Dorsey double/triple top and bottom signals; C5 bullish support line from lowest O in last 30 columns; C6 vertical count = 3 x boxes of the buy-signal column; C7 completed = not the last column. Bars normalised by first shipped close.
